description: Execute a declared fixed-skeleton body pose trajectory or an explicitly selected Chaos ragdoll without action-name routing.
physical_assumptions: A single harness UE mannequin and fixed UE4 bone set define the articulated body.
Kinematic root and component-space joint offsets are declared as timed keyframes.
Chaos ragdoll starts only at the explicitly declared time and never as an automatic fallback.
verifier_rules: Validate the declared root and joint trajectory through the existing trajectory artifact.
repair_suggestions: Correct the fixed model ID, standard bone names, keyframe times, joint ranges or execution mode.
